label: Class 1 Explosives
definition: Explosive substances and articles (divisions 1.1–1.6 recorded as subsidiary detail)

label: Division 2.1 Flammable Gas
definition: Flammable gases including many aerosols and gas cartridges

label: Division 2.2 Non-Flammable, Non-Toxic Gas
definition: Non-flammable, non-toxic gases including non-flammable aerosols

label: Class 3 Flammable Liquid
definition: Flammable liquids including alcohol-based fragrances, solvents and fuels

label: Division 4.1 Flammable Solid
definition: Flammable solids, self-reactive substances and desensitised explosives

label: Division 4.3 Dangerous When Wet
definition: Substances which emit flammable gases in contact with water

label: Class 9 Miscellaneous
definition: Miscellaneous dangerous substances and articles including lithium and sodium-ion batteries, magnetised material and environmentally hazardous substances

label: Not Regulated
definition: Explicit declaration that the product is not regulated for transport in the evaluated modes (an explicit value, never a default)
